grid=[list(map(int,line.split())) for line in grid_txt.splitlines()]
# Find 4connected components of cells !=7
from collections import deque
R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0]); comps=[]; seen=set()
for r in range(R):
 for c in range(C):
  if grid[r][c]==7 or (r,c) in seen: continue
  q=deque([(r,c)]); seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
  while q:
   x,y=q.popleft(); cells.append((x,y))
   for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
    nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
    if 0<=nx<R and 0<=ny<C and grid[nx][ny]!=7 and (nx,ny) not in seen:
     seen.add((nx,ny));q.append((nx,ny))
  comps.append(cells)
for i,cells in enumerate(comps):
 vals=sorted(set(grid[r][c] for r,c in cells if grid[r][c]!=0))
 print(i, (min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)),len(cells),vals, 'seed',cells[0])
